svg.text: Sheets that touch are joined: a design carries across them. A sheet marked "separate sheet" does not join its neighbour. Hatched ground = no surface here. Cross-hatched belongs to the sheet named on it, and only that sheet cuts a whole-part design there. Its own per-zone sheet still reaches that surface
